title: Period from graph
description: Essential: Student correctly extracts the period T = 0.4π s from the F-t graph in Figure 2.

title: Pendulum length calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the pendulum length L = 0.4 m using T = 2π√(L/g).

title: Force analysis at extremes
description: Important: Student identifies that minimum tension F_min occurs at highest points (A/C) and equals mgcosθ.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Student applies conservation of mechanical energy between highest and lowest points: mgL(1-cosθ) = ½mv².

title: Mass determination
description: Essential: Student correctly solves for mass m = 0.05 kg using F_min and energy relations.

title: Maximum speed calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates maximum speed v_max = 0.283 m/s at lowest point B.

title: Small-angle approximation
description: Optional: Student notes that θ < 5° justifies simple harmonic motion assumptions.

title: Sign error in tension
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly writes tension formula at highest point as mg(1-cosθ) or mgsinθ.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Student uses inconsistent units (e.g., cm instead of m) or omits units in final answers.
